parsing_notes: Extraction method: pdfplumber table detection (find_tables) on the real text layer of all 398 pages (confirmed non-OCR, extractable text). The register alternates strictly Front/Back page pairs for every ward block (199 front pages with SI No./Name/Class/Condition/Locality/Boundaries/Valuation columns, 199 back pages with Survey No./Area/Muttawali/Remarks columns), which was verified programmatically (pattern 'FBFBFB...' across all 398 pages). Front and back rows were zipped in document order to merge a property's descriptive fields with its survey number, muttawali, and registration remarks. 19 of 199 front/back page pairs had a row-count mismatch (usually off by 1-4 rows, likely from a long entry's description spilling across a page break); in those pairs only the rows that could be safely aligned were merged, and remaining rows on either side were pushed to unparsed_entries rather than guessed at. Ward assignment: each record's own 'Village/Ward' table cell was used when it parsed to a valid ward number (1-25); otherwise a page-level 'WARD NO.X' section-header context was used, tracked with monotonic correction to reject OCR noise (e.g. the recurring document title 'WARD NO.1 TO WARD NO.25' on every back page, and false matches like 'outward No.378'). Coverage: 340 structured records across 23 of 25 wards after de-duplication (missing: Ward 12, Ward 25 - likely thin/short sections whose rows didn't survive the placeholder/blank-row filter, not necessarily absent from the source PDF). Quality varies by ward: Wards 1-11 have clean District='Hyderabad'/Mandal='-' columns; from roughly Ward 12/13 onward, the source table's 'District' and 'Mandal' cells frequently overflow with property-description narrative instead of short place labels (a source formatting/column-width inconsistency, not an extraction bug) - this was detected and folded into 'property_description', with 'locality' then best-effort guessed via a 'situated at ...' regex or left as a generic 'Hyderabad' or null. 'survey_number' is populated from the back-page Sy.No. column when present, else falls back to the front-page 'Municipal Number' column when it looks like a survey-number pattern (e.g. '1-9-641/1 to 5'). 'category' is a keyword heuristic over name/class/condition/description text (mosque/dargah/graveyard/ashoorkhana/chillah), defaulting to 'other' when no keyword matched (this includes many genuine wakf-alal-aulad/family endowments, wakf boards, and properties described only by house/mulgi number). Placeholder rows explicitly marked in the source as 'Page No.X is missing' / 'entries missing from Col.No...' were excluded from records and kept in unparsed_entries instead of being fabricated.
